title: Great show and great ice cream- who could ask for anything more? Than...
transcript: Is there any better feeling than leaving a Broadway theater already riding that high, and immediately being greeted by an ice cream truck? Because if there is, I certainly haven't found it. This was at John Proctor is the villain as part of their Spirit Week Celebration. They even had members of the cast serving the ice cream, and it was just the best time. Because if you don't know, John Proctor is the villain is one of my favorite shows on Broadway right now. It's my pick for best play at the Tony Awards. So what better way to follow up this incredible show than with some free ice cream? And while sadly it was only one night only, I do have some good news for you, as this is only the first of many Spirit Week activities that they are doing throughout the week. Wednesday they're giving out some band books. Thursday they're hosting a Silent Disco. Friday they're encouraging you to come repping your school. I think there's gonna be like a photo op moment. And then, in my opinion, the most exciting this weekend at every single performance, both show Saturday and Sunday, they're giving out limited edition posters. Going to be a different poster at each show. And I love a poster, so I might have to go back for one. So yeah. If you have not seen John Proctor as the villain yet 1 what are you doing? Go see John Proctor as the Villain but 2 this is a really good week to do it there's gonna be a ton of fun events going on throughout the week.
classificationReason: Creator clearly attended (present at Spirit Week ice cream event with cast members) and shares a strong first-hand opinion ('one of my favorite shows on Broadway right now,' 'my pick for best play at the Tony Awards').
